subject: ACME trial — procurement readiness & billing start (post-demo)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acme.com>, ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: ACME trial — procurement readiness & billing start (post-demo)

Hi Jane / ACME team,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and next steps so procurement has what they need to move us toward a trial-to-paid path:

- Success criteria we agreed on:
  - 3 production-like flows across two teams
  - >= 75% of generated responses meeting accuracy threshold (as measured by your eval set)
  - 7 days of sustained usage at ~50k tokens/day before conversion discussion

- Trial details:
  - Trial provisioning is already live for your team (expires 2027-03-31).
  - We can start billing either: (A) on a calendar date you select, or (B) when usage crosses an agreed threshold. Both are fine — see options below.

Procurement / commercial questions we typically see: PO vs card, invoicing terms (Net30/Net45), marketplace listing, and SOW/MSA routing. To help your procurement team: I attached a short SOW and a one-page terms summary.

Options for billing start (pick one):
1) Start on a mutually agreed date (e.g., 2027-04-01) — simplest if you want a clean billing month.
2) Start when trial usage crosses X tokens (e.g., 100k tokens aggregate) — useful if you want trial-driven conversion.

Payment methods: for Hosted API we accept card for self-serve startups. For enterprise billing (PO/invoice) we route through an MSA and can do Net30. If you prefer marketplace purchase (AWS Marketplace), we can enable that pathway as well — that affects invoicing flow.

Next steps I propose:
- Procurement call: Wed 2027-03-10 or Thu 2027-03-11 (30 min) to confirm PO path, invoicing contact, and signing steps.
- If procurement prefers, we can start MSA + DocuSign and accept PO once MSA is executed.

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_Terms_Summary.pdf

If you can share the procurement contact and preferred billing option (date vs usage threshold), I’ll get the contracting and billing team looped in.

Thanks — I’ll block 30 minutes Wed/Thu for a short sync unless you prefer another time.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0112

From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME trial — procurement readiness & billing start (post-demo)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap. A few procurement questions so we can prep internally:

- We prefer invoicing via PO with Net30. Is that supported for the hosted trial if we convert to a paid plan, or do we need an enterprise purchase?
- Can you confirm the exact billing impact if we choose a usage-threshold start vs a calendar start? Would we be billed only for tokens after that threshold/date?
- Is Redwood available on AWS Marketplace? Our procurement prefers marketplace purchases where possible.
- Do you have SOC 2 or other certs we can attach to the security questionnaire?

Also our tentative target for starting paid billing is the week of 2027-04-01, but that depends on procurement cycles. Can we schedule the procurement call for Thu 2027-03-11 11:00am PT?

Thanks,
Jane Smith
Director of Product, ACME Corp
jane.smith@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acme.com>, ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME trial — procurement readiness & billing start (post-demo)

Hi Jane — great questions. Quick answers and proposed plan: 

- PO / Net30: Yes, we support PO and Net30 for enterprise purchases (MSA + order form). For hosted accounts with no enterprise contract we default to card, but we can provision an invoice path once the MSA is in place.

- Billing impact: If you pick a usage-threshold start (option B), billing will begin on the first billing period after the threshold is crossed and will bill for consumption from that start point forward. If you pick calendar-date start (option A), billing begins on that date for consumption thereafter. We do not retroactively bill for consumption during the trial unless you elect to convert and we explicitly agree to backfill (rare).

- AWS Marketplace: We are available on AWS Marketplace (SaaS listing). If you prefer that route, procurement will manage through the marketplace flow — note that invoicing & payment terms are subject to marketplace rules and timing.

- Compliance artifacts: I’ve included a link to our SOC 2 summary in the terms PDF; happy to open a SOC 2 evidence call with security if needed.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_Terms_Summary.pdf
DocuSign (MSA template): https://redwood.app/docusign/abc123
HubSpot record: hubspot:123456

Proposed next steps:
- Procurement call: Thu 2027-03-11 11:00am PT (confirmed) — invite to follow.
- I’ll share an MSA + order form via DocuSign after the call so procurement can route for PO.
- If you want billing to start 2027-04-01, say so in the call and we’ll set that as the calendar start.

Dylan (CC) will join for any pricing/order questions.

Best,
Marissa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ACME procurement call prep

Quick internal note — thanks for the thread. I’ll join Thu’s call and bring the order-form template and pricing breakout.

A couple items to confirm before the call:
- Preferred billing start: Jane mentioned week of 2027-04-01 — confirm if they want an exact date or usage-threshold (I think 100k tokens was discussed as a threshold).
- If procurement requests Net30 + PO, we’ll need the signed MSA before enabling invoice flow.

I’ll prep the MSA + order form and pricing scenarios (card vs PO) and upload to the call invite.

-Dylan
